name: CallElimCorrect.substOldPostSubset
candidate:
open OldExpressions in
theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  induction post <;>
    simp only [substOld, Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars,
      Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.Subset, List.append_assoc,
      List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton, List.not_mem_nil,
      false_implies, forall_const, forall_eq, false_or,
      true_or] at * <;> try assumption
  case quant ih₁ ih₂ | eq ih₁ ih₂ =>
    intro x h
    rcases h with h | h
    · exact (ih₁ h).imp id Or.inr
    · exact Or.inr (ih₂ h)
  case ite ih₁ ih₂ ih₃ =>
    intro x h
    rcases h with h | h | h
    · exact (ih₁ h).imp id fun h => Or.inr (Or.inr h)
    · exact Or.inr ((ih₂ h).imp id Or.inr)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (ih₃ h))
  case app ih₁ ih₂ =>
    split
    · split <;> simp [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars]
    · simp only [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.mem_append]
      intro x h
      rcases h with h | h
      · exact (ih₁ h).imp id Or.inr
      · exact Or.inr (ih₂ h)
